title: [MAIN]-Bug 647352 Issue with lot no assignment after posting a transfer order
summary: Transfer shipments for tracked items now correctly consume the matching lot or serial number instead of incorrectly reducing other lot quantities, by rejecting mismatched reservations and applying proper tracking filters.
key_points: Fixes incorrect lot number reduction in transfer orders caused by reservation-based application not validating lot/serial tracking
Adds validation to reject mismatched reservations that don't correspond to the correct tracking dimension
Applies transfer tracking filters to ensure outbound entries consume the correct lot or serial number
Changes made across multiple localization layers (APAC, CH, ES, IT, RU, W1) to ensure consistent behavior
Includes test updates to verify the fix works correctly
quote: Reject mismatched reservations and apply transfer tracking filters so the outbound entry consumes the correct lot
